harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/numeric-record-ordering/bin/merge. It now performs numeric transaction ordering, preserves quoted CSV fields, emits one header, collapses identical duplicates, rejects conflicting duplicates with diagnostics, and publishes atomically so failed merges preserve the existing output. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged. The repair persisted across the required node restart.
actions_performed: Implemented a POSIX sh/awk solution using existing platform software.
Verified the quoted field "Tape, wide" remains intact and duplicate ID 2 collapses.
Verified conflicting ID 2 exits nonzero, identifies both records, and leaves merged.csv byte-identical.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Re-ran successful and conflicting merges after restart.

evidence.requirement: Repair and successful numeric CSV merge
evidence.summary: Installed and syntax-checked the repaired executable; exact assertions prove numeric order, one header, quoted-comma preservation, and identical-duplicate collapse.

evidence.requirement: Conflicting duplicates stop publication and explain the conflict
evidence.summary: Merge exited 1, reported both conflicting ID 2 records and source lines, and matching before/after SHA-256 values prove the published output remained intact.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 21dcd328-8552-4ccb-ad47-7e66f008a164, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID c325992d-8c72-48f9-b019-c848971f9116, and proved the persisted script/data support both successful publication and safe conflict rejection after recovery.
